spec_defects.spec: type=http, scheme=custom causes HTTP scheme/prefix security validation, rejecting the published header
spec_defects.documented_contract: Authorization: userKey:signature, without any HTTP authentication-scheme prefix. The documentation PHP example base64-encodes the hexadecimal SHA1 HMAC of path + RFC1738 parameters + MD5(parameters).
blocking_failures: request: ValueError: Authentication is missing or in the wrong location/scheme
request: SecurityValidationError: Security not found; ApiKeyAuth
spec_defects.resolution: Keep the documented userKey:signature header. The OpenAPI security scheme should be type=apiKey, in=header, name=Authorization.

spec_defects.spec: The form schema declares number as an array.
spec_defects.documented_contract: number is a phone-number string; multiple recipients are separated by commas. This integration supports one recipient per request.
spec_defects.resolution: Keep number as a scalar form value, as the provider documentation instructs.
